description:
The image features two keyboards, one placed on top of the other, with the bottom keyboard being the primary focus.

Both keyboards are predominantly black, with the top one encased in a clear plastic cover, while the bottom one is a standard, full-size keyboard with a flat, rectangular design. The bottom keyboard is positioned on a wooden surface, with a black USB cable and plug situated above it. The brand name "FILCO" is printed in small letters on the right side of the keyboard
